exposure: Fetal weight estimation by clinical methods (Johnson's formula)
Fetal weight estimation by clinical methods (Dare's formula)
Fetal weight estimation by ultrasonography (USG) (Hadlock's formula)
cohort: The study included 90 pregnant women attending the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology for routine antenatal check-up.
finding: USG using Hadlock's formula provided the most accurate estimations of fetal weight, although Johnson's method performed best among the clinical approaches.
birth_weight: Mean birth weights were 2970 g for multigravidas and 2902 g for primigravidas, with some cases included only if birth weight was >1 kg.
